description: Sacramento County (FIPS 06067) parcel land-use layer for the FactLot Registry collector. Open data (Creative Commons zero / public-domain dedication on the item); the file has situs, land-use class and lot size but no assessed values and no owner names. Review record: docs/registry/sources/ca-sacramento-assessor.md.

sources.notes: Item 8d011b99aebc46d48060b2e5bdd7f4a0 'Parcels' (owner SCGISAdmin, hosted feature layer, 502,447 parcels, modified 2026-11-01). Fields: APN (14 digits), situs, lot size, a land-use classification (Landuse code, General, Specific, Detail). NO assessed values, NO owner names, NO year built or building area. The Hub download API honours a where filter on the field names; the three files fetch only the in-scope classes (Retail / Commercial, Office, Industrial; apartments, hotels, motels and mobile home parks under Residential; Care / Health; Recreational) instead of all 502k rows. The export answers 302 to services1.arcgis.com/.../replicafilescache/*.csv; the item is 466 MB with geometry, so the unfiltered export was not requested. robots.txt on data.saccounty.gov sets Crawl-delay: 60, which the collector honours. The Assessor sells nothing here: its fee schedule gives the secured roll in electronic form 'at no charge' on e-mail request to assessor@saccounty.gov (values and owner names would come that way; that is a person's action, not done).
